services.name: Guided Fishing
services.desc: A 3-4 hour guided fishing trip that includes exclusive private tour experiences: You are able to customize your Alaskan River Adventure, based on your personal preferences and choices. Smoke salmon sampling from salmon caught on Twentymile river and professionally processed. A possible riverside campfire that we will cook one or two of your freshly caught fish, depends on weather and how early in the trip fish are caught. Transportation to and from river from within the Anchorage bowl, if needed, in a Denali XL luxury SUV or luxury pickup truck (depending on group size and availability). Exclusive private boat tour only Hope Fishing Charters swag. Bottled water and your preferred beverage
